description: This file defines a class HTMLPurifier_Strategy_ValidateAttributes responsible for validating attributes of HTML tokens within the HTMLPurifier library. It implements an execute method that processes a list of tokens, validates relevant ones, and manages context state during validation.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Strategy_ValidateAttributes
classes.description: Class responsible for validating attributes of HTML tokens, extending the HTMLPurifier_Strategy class.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Processes a list of tokens, validates those that are start or empty tags, skips armored tokens, and manages context; returns the validated tokens.
